pages.text: In this ritual an $(#ad03fc)djinni$() will possess an $(#ad03fc)Bee$(), Be careful,$(br) a bee invoked by this way does not lose its stinger, always poison the target,$(br) attacks faster and can summon other bees when it takes damage.$(br) This is the $()
only known method to obtain $(item)Cursed Honey$(), eating will grants$(br) a short regeneration buff.$(br2) If this bee enters a hive, the djinni will return to $(#ad03fc)The Other Place$().$(br)
